nodes.title: SpeedTAS
nodes.what: A static website on GitHub Pages plus a robot (GitHub Actions) that keeps its data fresh. The browser does all the maths; the robot only collects data, draws preview pictures and checks the site.

nodes.title: Website
nodes.what: Everything the visitor's browser runs. One HTML page, one stylesheet and twelve plain JavaScript files loaded in order. They share one global scope, so a later file can use anything from an earlier one.
nodes.tip: Load order matters only for code that runs immediately; inside functions anything can be used. To add a file, add a script tag in index.html and a row in the README.

nodes.title: Config & seasons
nodes.what: The settings: sheet links, points table, season list (S1, S2, S3 with best 9 of 12), schedule breaks, the edition hour and the shared state variables.
nodes.tip: Change a season's start date, edition count or breaks here. The data robot reads this file too, for the missing-results check.

nodes.title: Player names
nodes.what: Makes text safe to show (escapeHtml) and treats different spellings of one player as the same person across seasons and games.
nodes.tip: A renamed player who shows up as two people needs an alias here.

nodes.title: Loading data
nodes.what: Gets the results into the browser: the saved data/*.json files first, then live Google Sheets (JSONP, no CORS) or the Worker, with retries and the fallback snapshot.
nodes.tip: If the site shows old numbers, this is where the source is chosen.

nodes.title: Race sources
nodes.what: Everything about a race beyond the placements: TM2020 sheet, TAS Exchange events, times, replays and the Inputs panel.
nodes.tip: Inputs come from data/inputs/ (TMNF) or data/inputs/tm20/ (TM2020); the folder is picked by game.

nodes.title: Avatars
nodes.what: Discord profile pictures: from the saved file, then the Worker in batches with retries, cached in the browser. Visitors can also set a custom picture.

nodes.title: Stats engine
nodes.what: computeAll turns a season's editions into the ranked table: points, wins, podiums, form, best-of dropping, tie-breaks and movement. Every page uses it.
nodes.tip: Never change points, ranking or tie-breaks without an explicit decision. Share-page pictures call this same function.

nodes.title: View helpers
nodes.what: Small reusable pieces of HTML: form chips, podiums, season pickers, avatar circles, colours per name, medal and movement icons, local time, themes and the game switch.

nodes.title: Router & boot
nodes.what: Reads the #/ address and draws the right page, runs the phone menu, start-up, search, refresh, the status banner, manual import and the tab title.
nodes.tip: Routes: home, players, player, history, edition, maps, records, rivalries, versus, videos, and #/tm20 for the TM2020 side.

nodes.title: Pages
nodes.what: One render function per page. Each builds HTML strings and puts them into the main element.

nodes.title: Home & standings
nodes.what: The standings table (sortable, Show all, CSV), the latest result card with its map, the countdown and live Saturday banner, and who can still win.

nodes.title: Players & profiles
nodes.what: The player directory and each profile: stats, Standing panel (gaps, best-of slots, ceiling), achievements, honors and charts.

nodes.title: History & editions
nodes.what: The edition list, and each edition page: full results, times, replays, inputs, the map card and the race video.

nodes.title: Head-to-head
nodes.what: Compare two players across seasons, race by race.

nodes.title: Records & rivalries
nodes.what: Player records, race records from times (closest win, biggest margin, tightest podium...) and the rivalry list.

nodes.title: Maps
nodes.what: Every map with its picture, author time, TAS record and how close the winner got.

nodes.title: Videos
nodes.what: YouTube uploads: Worker, then the public RSS feed, merged with the saved data/videos.json.

nodes.title: Charts
nodes.what: Title race and profile charts with Chart.js (served from the site). If it can't load, each chart says so.

nodes.title: Sharing
nodes.what: Copy link (uses the share pages), the Discord results post with pings and clip, and the downloadable season/champion card.

nodes.title: Data robot
nodes.what: scripts/update-data.mjs is the run order (sheets, events, auto-import, inputs, maps, avatars, videos, missing-results check, report), the self-test and the command line; the parts live in scripts/lib/. Run by GitHub Actions. A source that fails keeps its previous file.
nodes.tip: npm test runs the offline self-test. --probe-maps and --probe-tm20 <event> <replay> test TMX search and the TM2020 decoder without saving.

nodes.title: Sources & sheets
nodes.what: config.mjs lists every source and limit (sheets, TAS Exchange event sets, TMX packs, map search, auto-import); sheets.mjs reads the Google Sheets like the Worker does; common.mjs has the shared HTTP and file helpers and the run report.

nodes.title: TAS Exchange events
nodes.what: Finds every SpeedTAS event on TAS Exchange with its results, times and replay ids; matches entrant names to sheet players and auto-imports Season 3 / TM2020 results before they're in the sheet.
nodes.tip: Event names must look like "SpeedTAS S3 #4" or "SpeedTAS Season 3 #4" to be recognised.

nodes.title: Inputs
nodes.what: TMNF inputs as TMInterface scripts from the replay API. TM2020 inputs from the event's replay download, decoded with TAS Exchange's own extractor in a locked-down process, with the seed.
nodes.tip: TMNF and TM2020 replays are numbered separately on TAS Exchange; never mix them. --probe-tm20 <event> <replay> tests one.

nodes.title: Maps & pictures
nodes.what: Map details from the TMX packs (S1, S2) or by name search ("SpeedTAS 3 #N"), TAS records, and map pictures saved to data/thumbs.

nodes.title: Avatars & videos
nodes.what: Discord pictures via the Worker (sorted so the file only changes when a picture does) and YouTube uploads linked to editions by title.

nodes.title: Guard & report
nodes.what: Refuses sheet data that would lose editions, warns about odd placements, spots a missing Saturday edition, and writes the run report and commit message.

nodes.title: Link previews
nodes.what: Pictures and pages Discord shows when a link is shared: the site's top-10 image and one share page per player, edition and season, plus the sitemap.
nodes.tip: share-pages.mjs opens the site in headless Chromium and draws each card with the site's own code. Bump DESIGN to redraw all.

nodes.title: Checks
nodes.what: npm run check: stamps assets, rebuilds this map, runs the self-test and site-check.mjs (every page on desktop and phone, outside services blocked, accessibility audit). npm run sim does the same with Season 3 sample data. CI fails if stamps or this map are out of date.
nodes.tip: After changing code: npm run check, then commit index.html and docs/project-map.md with the change.

nodes.title: GitHub Actions
nodes.what: update-data.yml: Saturday every 30 min, Sunday, Wednesday; fetch, previews, test, publish, open or close the data-update issue. site-check.yml: on every push.
nodes.tip: "Run workflow" has options: sheets only, allow removals, rebuild share pages.

nodes.title: Data files
nodes.what: What the robot writes and the site reads: results per season (s1, s2, s3, tm20), events and times, maps and thumbs, inputs, avatars, videos, share index and the og image.
where: data/fixtures/s3-sample.json (Season 3 sample for npm run sim)

nodes.title: Outside services
nodes.what: Google Sheets (official results), TAS Exchange (events, times, replays, inputs), TMX (maps), YouTube (videos), Discord via the Cloudflare Worker (avatars), GitHub Pages (hosting). All optional: the site keeps working when one is down.
where: Cloudflare Worker: SPEEDTAS_API_URL in 01-config.js (code not in this repo)

fdesc.escapeHtml: makes text safe to put in HTML
fdesc.canonicalizeDataset: merges spellings of the same player
fdesc.discordIdFor: Discord ID for a player name
fdesc.withBestOf: adds the best-of rule to a season
fdesc.fetchViaJSONP: reads a Google Sheet without CORS
fdesc.fillLatestMap: map strip on the latest result
fdesc.render: draws the page for the address
fdesc.attachEditionEvent: TAS Exchange link and runs on an edition
fdesc.shareUrl: share page address for a player or edition
fdesc.autoImport: results from times before the sheet
fdesc.resolveName: TAS Exchange name to sheet name
fdesc.tm2020Decoder: runs it in a locked-down process
fdesc.tm2020ScriptProblem: why a TM2020 script is rejected
fdesc.searchTracks: finds maps on TMX by name
fdesc.prune: removes pages that no longer exist
